plan.title: Technical-stage required T&C blocks vendor submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Provide the required event title.
Create the requested Technical plus RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the requested line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite Vendor A from the QA vendor pool.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Verify that publishing reached the project page.
Open the invited vendor's separate supplier-portal session.
Open the event's Technical stage as the vendor.
Accept only the optional clause.
Complete the technical response using the vendor portal's quick-fill control.
Try to submit with the required Payment clause still unaccepted; the submission must be refused.
Verify that the required clause is identified on the vendor screen after the blocked submission.
Accept the required clause after the bypass attempt.
Submit the Technical response after accepting all required clauses.
Verify that the Technical-stage submission succeeds once the required clause is accepted.
Open the RFQ pricing stage to verify stage-specific clause scope.
The Technical-stage required clause must not be shown on the RFQ stage.
The optional Technical-stage clause must also not be shown on the RFQ stage.
